files.nav.tab.description: Navigation tab label for the Files module (Drive-backed file storage). Also the Menu-tab row label when the module overflows the bottom bar (design: docs/files-tab-design.md §UX).

files.nav.more_section.description: Section header at the top of the Menu tab listing modules that did not fit the bottom bar (bar cap = 4 modules + Menu). Shown only when at least one module overflowed.

files.home.title.description: Top app bar title of the Files screen at the top level.

files.home.root_label.description: Breadcrumb label for the top level (folder_id NULL); first crumb on every folder screen.

files.home.search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the Files search field. Search is GLOBAL across the business (all folders the member can access), case-insensitive name substring.

files.home.empty_title.description: Empty-state title when the top level has no folders and no files.

files.home.empty_message.value: शुरू करने के लिए फ़ाइलें अपलोड करें या फ़ोल्डर बनाएँ।
files.home.empty_message.description: Empty-state body under files.home.empty_title (shown to members who can upload or manage folders; viewers see the title only).

files.folder.empty_title.description: Empty-state title inside a folder with no subfolders and no files.

files.search.empty.value: कोई मिलती-जुलती फ़ाइल या फ़ोल्डर नहीं
files.search.empty.description: Empty-state text when a Files search returns no results.

files.search.result_path.description: Subtitle under a search result: the folder path it lives in. {path} = 'All files › Contracts › 2026' style breadcrumb string.

files.breadcrumb.separator.description: Separator glyph between breadcrumb crumbs (kept in the catalog so both apps render the same path string, incl. in files.search.result_path).

files.breadcrumb.up.description: Accessibility label of the back/up affordance that navigates to the parent folder.

files.view.grid.description: Toggle action / a11y label: switch the listing to a thumbnail grid.

files.view.list.description: Toggle action / a11y label: switch the listing to a detail list.

files.action.upload.description: Primary action (FAB / toolbar button): pick one or more files to upload into the current folder. Hidden without files.upload.

files.action.new_folder.description: Action: create a subfolder in the current folder. Hidden without files.manage_folders (which inherits files.upload when unset).

files.action.rename_folder.description: Folder kebab / long-press action. Hidden without files.manage_folders.

files.action.delete_folder.description: Folder kebab / long-press action: tombstone the folder and everything inside. Hidden without files.delete.

files.action.delete_file.description: File kebab / long-press / viewer action: tombstone the file (best-effort Drive delete). Hidden without files.delete.

files.action.open.description: File action: open the file (images in the in-app viewer; everything else in Google Drive's viewer in the browser).

files.action.open_in_drive.description: File action: open the Drive viewer page for this file in the browser / a custom tab.

files.action.download.description: File action: save a copy to the device (Android: Download/Samaroh via MediaStore; web: browser download).

files.action.copy_link.description: File action: copy the anyone-with-link Drive URL to the clipboard.

files.action.manage_access.description: Folder kebab action (OWNER only): open the restricted-folder allow-list editor.

files.action.more.description: Accessibility label of the per-item kebab (more options) button on a file or folder row/tile; {name} = file or folder name.

files.folder.name_label.description: Text field label in the new-folder / rename-folder dialog.

files.folder.name_required.description: Validation error when the folder name is blank.

files.folder.name_invalid.value: फ़ोल्डर के नाम में / नहीं हो सकता और वह 120 अक्षरों से लंबा नहीं हो सकता
files.folder.name_invalid.description: Validation error mirroring the server CHECK on folders.name (no slash, 1–120 chars).

files.folder.duplicate.value: इस नाम का फ़ोल्डर यहाँ पहले से है
files.folder.duplicate.description: Validation error: another LIVE folder in the same parent has this name (case-insensitive) — mirrors uq_folders_biz_parent_name.

files.folder.created.description: Snackbar after a folder is created.

files.folder.renamed.description: Snackbar after a folder is renamed.

files.folder.delete_confirm_title.description: Confirmation dialog title before tombstoning a folder.

files.folder.delete_confirm_message.value: {count, plural, one {फ़ोल्डर और उसके अंदर की # चीज़ सभी सदस्यों के लिए हट जाएगी।} other {फ़ोल्डर और उसके अंदर की # चीज़ें सभी सदस्यों के लिए हट जाएँगी।}}
files.folder.delete_confirm_message.description: Confirmation body before deleting a NON-empty folder; {count} = live subfolders + files underneath (recursive, ≥1). Empty folders use files.folder.delete_confirm_message_empty.

files.folder.delete_confirm_message_empt.value: फ़ोल्डर सभी सदस्यों के लिए हट जाएगा।
files.folder.delete_confirm_message_empt.description: Confirmation body before deleting an EMPTY folder (count = 0; ICU has no exact-zero branch on Android).

files.folder.icon_a11y.description: Accessibility description of the folder icon in grid/list rows.

files.folder.item_count.description: Secondary line of a folder row: number of live direct children (subfolders + files), ≥1. Empty folders use files.folder.item_count_empty.

files.folder.item_count_empty.description: Secondary line of a folder row with no live children (count = 0; ICU has no exact-zero branch on Android).

files.file.delete_confirm_title.description: Confirmation dialog title before tombstoning a file.

files.file.delete_confirm_message.value: यह सभी सदस्यों के लिए हट जाएगी। इसे वापस नहीं लाया जा सकता।
files.file.delete_confirm_message.description: Confirmation body before deleting a file.

files.file.pending_label.description: Badge on a locally staged file whose Drive upload has not finished yet (Android outbox; the row is not on the server until it does).

files.file.added_by.description: Detail line: display name of the member who uploaded the file.

files.file.thumbnail_a11y.description: Accessibility description of an image/PDF thumbnail; {name} = file name.

files.file.open_failed.value: फ़ाइल खोल नहीं सके। अपना इंटरनेट कनेक्शन जाँचकर फिर से कोशिश करें।
files.file.open_failed.description: Error snackbar when opening/downloading a file fails (network, or Drive withheld the file).

files.file.download_done.description: Android snackbar after files.action.download copies the file into public Downloads.

files.file.size_kb.description: File size label under 1 MB; {size} = locale-formatted number (no decimals).

files.file.size_mb.description: File size label at or above 1 MB; {size} = locale-formatted number with one decimal.

files.upload.too_large.value: {name} 25 MB से बड़ी है, इसे छोड़ दिया गया
files.upload.too_large.description: Error when a picked file exceeds the 25 MiB cap (mirrors the server CHECK on files.size_bytes); {name} = file name.

files.upload.too_many.value: आप एक बार में अधिकतम {max} फ़ाइलें अपलोड कर सकते हैं
files.upload.too_many.description: Error when more than {max} (=20) files are picked or shared in one go.

files.upload.in_progress.description: Progress label while a batch uploads; {done}/{total} counts.

files.upload.done.value: {count, plural, one {# फ़ाइल अपलोड हो गई} other {# फ़ाइलें अपलोड हो गईं}}
files.upload.done.description: Snackbar after a batch finishes (web: immediately; Android: after the Drive upload + row push).

files.upload.queued.value: {count, plural, one {# फ़ाइल ऑनलाइन होने पर अपलोड होगी} other {# फ़ाइलें ऑनलाइन होने पर अपलोड होंगी}}
files.upload.queued.description: Android snackbar when files were staged offline (outbox); they upload on the next connected sync.

files.upload.failed.value: {name} अपलोड नहीं हो सकी। कनेक्शन जाँचकर फिर से कोशिश करें।
files.upload.failed.description: Error when a single file's Drive upload fails; {name} = file name.

files.upload.pending_unlinked.value: फ़ाइल अभी इसी फ़ोन पर है - Drive में सुरक्षित रखने के लिए Settings में अपना Google खाता जोड़ें
files.upload.pending_unlinked.description: Android hint on staged files while no Google account is linked (uploads stay local until the user links).

files.upload.link_google_title.description: Title of the link-Google prompt shown when an unlinked user taps Upload.

files.upload.link_google_message.value: फ़ाइलें आपके Google Drive में सुरक्षित रहती हैं और आपकी टीम के साथ साझा होती हैं। अपलोड करने के लिए अपना Google खाता जोड़ें।
files.upload.link_google_message.description: Body of the link-Google prompt (Android: Credential Manager link flow; web: Google consent popup).

files.upload.link_google_connect.description: Confirm button of the link-Google prompt.

files.upload.link_google_later.description: Dismiss button of the link-Google prompt.

files.upload.link_failed.value: Google से जोड़ नहीं सके। फिर से कोशिश करें।
files.upload.link_failed.description: Error snackbar when the Google link/consent flow fails or is cancelled.

files.upload.not_configured.value: इस साइट पर अपलोड अभी सेट नहीं है। फ़ाइलें जोड़ने के लिए मोबाइल ऐप इस्तेमाल करें।
files.upload.not_configured.description: Web-only: shown when the deployment has no Google web client id configured (NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID).

files.upload.guest_hint.value: फ़ाइलें Google Drive में सहेजने के लिए साइन इन करें।
files.upload.guest_hint.description: Web guest mode: shown in place of the upload action (guest has no Google account to upload with).

files.upload.drop_hint.value: अपलोड करने के लिए फ़ाइलें यहाँ छोड़ें
files.upload.drop_hint.description: Web-only overlay text while dragging files over the folder view.

files.access.restricted_badge.description: Badge/chip on a restricted folder (folders.restricted = true).

files.access.title.value: यह फ़ोल्डर कौन खोल सकता है
files.access.title.description: Title of the OWNER-only folder access editor.

files.access.everyone.value: फ़ाइलें देखने की अनुमति वाले सभी
files.access.everyone.description: Access editor option: folder is not restricted (any member with files.view sees it).

files.access.only_selected.description: Access editor option: folder is restricted to the members ticked below (folder_access rows).

files.access.subfolders_note.value: उप-फ़ोल्डर इसी फ़ोल्डर की पहुँच मानते हैं।
files.access.subfolders_note.description: Helper text in the access editor: restrictions apply to the whole subtree.

files.access.owner_always.description: Helper text in the access editor.

files.access.no_members.value: अभी कोई सदस्य नहीं। पहले सदस्य स्क्रीन से सदस्य जोड़ें।
files.access.no_members.description: Access editor empty state when the business has no non-owner members.

files.access.saved.description: Snackbar after saving the access editor.

files.access.no_access.value: आपके पास इस फ़ोल्डर की पहुँच नहीं है।
files.access.no_access.description: Shown when a deep link / stale local row points at a folder the member can no longer open.

files.permission.group.description: Permission matrix group header for the files module (rendered like auth.permissions.group_booking).

files.permission.action_view.description: Permission toggle for files.view: open the Files tab, browse folders, search, open/download files.

files.permission.action_upload.description: Permission toggle for files.upload: add files (and, unless files.manage_folders is set off explicitly, create folders).

files.permission.action_manage_folders.description: Permission toggle for files.manage_folders. ABSENT = inherits files.upload — clients normalize exactly like the DB: coalesce(manage_folders, upload, false). Set false explicitly to let a member upload without changing the folder structure.

files.permission.action_delete.description: Permission toggle for files.delete: remove files and folders for every member (tombstone + best-effort Drive delete).

files.share_target.label.description: System share-sheet label of the app's single share target (images, PDFs, any file; single or multiple).

files.share_target.chooser_title.description: Title of the chooser dialog shown after a share: create invoice / set item photo / save to Files.

files.share_target.option_invoice_subtit.value: किसी खर्च एंट्री में बिल के रूप में जोड़ें
files.share_target.option_invoice_subtit.description: Subtitle of the 'Create invoice' chooser row (title reuses expenses.share_target.label). Single image or PDF only; hidden without expenses.create.

files.share_target.option_inventory.description: Chooser row: use the shared image as an inventory master item's photo. Single image only; hidden without inventory.manage_master_items.

files.share_target.option_inventory_subt.value: इस फ़ोटो को इन्वेंटरी आइटम के लिए इस्तेमाल करें

files.share_target.option_files.description: Chooser row: upload the shared file(s) into the Files module. Any type, single or multiple; hidden without files.upload.

files.share_target.option_files_subtitle.value: अपने व्यवसाय के फ़ाइल स्टोरेज में रखें

files.share_target.pick_folder_title.description: Title of the folder picker shown after choosing Save to Files (top level preselected).

files.share_target.pick_item_title.value: यह फ़ोटो किस आइटम की है?
files.share_target.pick_item_title.description: Title of the master-item type-ahead picker shown after choosing Set as item photo.

files.share_target.saved.value: {count, plural, one {# फ़ाइल फ़ाइलें में सहेज दी गई} other {# फ़ाइलें फ़ाइलें में सहेज दी गईं}}
files.share_target.saved.description: Snackbar after a share-sheet save into Files is staged/uploaded.

files.share_target.signed_out.value: फ़ाइलें सहेजने के लिए साइन इन करके अपना व्यवसाय खोलें।
files.share_target.signed_out.description: Chooser message when the device has no signed-in session / active business.

files.share_target.no_options.value: इस फ़ाइल पर किसी भी कार्य की अनुमति आपके पास नहीं है।
files.share_target.no_options.description: Chooser message when every row is permission-hidden for this member and file type.

files.share_target.unsupported.value: यह फ़ाइल प्रकार यहाँ इस्तेमाल नहीं हो सकता।
files.share_target.unsupported.description: Chooser message when a share carries no usable stream (no MIME / unreadable content URI).

files.action.rename_file.description: File kebab / long-press action: change the display name (and best-effort the Drive file name). Hidden unless the member holds files.delete OR uploaded this file and holds files.upload — exactly the server's files UPDATE policy.

files.action.move.description: File / folder kebab / long-press action: choose another folder as the new location (lazy folder picker). Files: hidden unless files.delete OR (own upload ∧ files.upload); folders: hidden without files.manage_folders.

files.file.name_label.description: Text field label in the rename-file dialog (prefilled with the current name incl. extension).

files.file.name_required.description: Validation error when the file name is blank.

files.file.name_invalid.value: फ़ाइल के नाम में / नहीं हो सकता और वह 255 अक्षरों से ज़्यादा नहीं हो सकता
files.file.name_invalid.description: Validation error mirroring the server CHECK on files.name (no slash, 1–255 chars).

files.file.renamed.value: फ़ाइल का नाम बदल दिया गया
files.file.renamed.description: Snackbar after a file is renamed.

files.file.no_viewer_app.value: इस फ़ोन पर इस प्रकार की फ़ाइल खोलने वाला कोई ऐप नहीं है
files.file.no_viewer_app.description: Android snackbar when the phone has no app able to display a tapped non-image file (e.g. no PDF viewer installed); the file was downloaded fine.

files.move.title.description: Title of the folder picker shown after files.action.move (the item's current folder is preselected).

files.move.confirm.description: Confirm button of the move folder picker.

files.move.done.description: Snackbar after a file or folder was moved; {folder} = destination folder name (files.home.root_label at the top level).

files.move.same_folder.value: यह पहले से इसी फ़ोल्डर में है
files.move.same_folder.description: Move picker inline error when the chosen destination is the item's current location.

files.move.into_self.value: फ़ोल्डर को उसके अपने या उसके किसी सब-फ़ोल्डर में नहीं ले जाया जा सकता
files.move.into_self.description: Move picker inline error (cycle guard) when a folder's destination is itself or a descendant.

files.move.too_deep.value: यहाँ ले जाने से फ़ोल्डर की गहराई की सीमा पार हो जाएगी
files.move.too_deep.description: Move picker inline error when the destination depth plus the moved folder's own subtree height would exceed the 10-level cap (design D13).

files.picker.expand.description: Accessibility label of the expand chevron on a folder-picker row that has subfolders (lazy tree); {name} = folder name.

files.picker.collapse.description: Accessibility label of the collapse chevron on an expanded folder-picker row; {name} = folder name.

files.move.selected_hint.description: Helper line under the folder list of the move picker (web; Android may reuse). {path} = the selected destination's breadcrumb path built like files.search.result_path (e.g. 'All files › Contracts').

files.move.duplicate_folder.value: गंतव्य में इस नाम का फ़ोल्डर पहले से है
files.move.duplicate_folder.description: Move picker inline error: a LIVE folder in the chosen destination already carries the moved folder's name (case-insensitive) — mirrors uq_folders_biz_parent_name (the server would answer 23505). Rename first.
